scope: Read-only second audit. Only this new JSON written. No archives/unlinks, executable ELF/source/result mutation, Git mutation, network, or compilation. Exact libforge_core.a filename only; vendor libraries excluded.
path_encoding: All directories are relative to directory_root. Library paths=directory_root+"/"+directories[directory_ids]+"/libforge_core.a"; object paths=directory_root+"/"+directories[directory_id]+"/"+filename. CMake source_home_ids reference cmake_source_homes.

summary.estimate_warning: Object savings estimated80%; library gzip6 sizes measured. Root may concurrently retire paths; re-stat/hash before archive.
summary.first_300MB_wave_components: Top200 singleton objects (80% estimate), top20 singleton libraries (measured), plus top10 known-source fully-accounted-hardlink libraries (measured). Only all-alias retirement reclaims hardlink inode bytes.

process_snapshot.note: FD-global absence cannot be proven due sandbox FD-link permissions; repeat closed leases before retirement.

recovery_rules: Only .o/.obj and source-known libforge_core.a caches are candidates; preserve every source, executable ELF, raw log/dataset/result and evidence byte.
Archive+fsync then independent decode/hash and byte-count verification before retirement. Preserve exact per-path metadata and every hardlink alias in append-safe restore map.
nlink>1 requires journaling every alias and retiring all aliases to reclaim inode bytes. Require known_forge_source and all_aliases_found true.
Largest measured singleton .a fits3.64MB gzip and gains14.46MB. Individual compression initially fits8MiB space.
SHA deduplicate only after each original path metadata and hash are recorded. Never GC Git or remove existing maps/archives.
